units.source_text: 另外一次给他翻身，一次给他喝茶。

en.t: Another time I turned him over, and another time I gave him tea to drink.

units.source_text: 他责备我：还不快点起来，我喊累了会喘气的。

en.t: He scolded me: Hurry up and get up. If I get tired from calling, I will be out of breath.

units.source_text: 可我睡得太死，约莫十二点才入睡，难以叫醒。

en.t: But I was sleeping too deeply; I had only fallen asleep around twelve, so I was hard to wake.
